response.courseDescription: 220 Introductory Accounting for Non-Business Majors Survey of selected introductory financial and managerial accounting topics. Credit not granted if credit has been earned in ACCTG 230 and/or 231. Does not substitute for either ACCTG 230 or ACCTG 231 for Business majors.
response.coursePrerequisites: Enrollment not allowed if credit already earned for ACCTG 230 or 231.
